acceptance_criteria.text: When the sidecar reports `Sync not running` during `lan-sync:broadcastChange`, Electron main must treat it as a benign stale-sync-state condition, avoid noisy warning spam, and return `false` to the renderer.
proof: apps/delphi/ts/electron/main.ts uses handleStaleSyncRuntime(...) in lan-sync:broadcastChange before warning
handleStaleSyncRuntime(...) matches Error messages containing 'Sync not running' and logs console.info instead of console.warn
raw/code-locations.txt and raw/main.diff capture the changed path

acceptance_criteria.text: When Electron main detects `Sync not running` from sidecar sync operations, it must reset its in-memory sync state (`syncActive` and related peer/runtime cache) so subsequent status checks do not continue to report sync as active.
proof: stop and leave-space handlers also reuse resetSyncRuntimeState()

acceptance_criteria.text: `lan-sync:getStatus` must return `{ active: false, peers: 0, peerNames: [] }` after a stale runtime is detected instead of claiming sync is still active with zero peers.
proof: apps/delphi/ts/electron/main.ts catch block in lan-sync:getStatus checks handleStaleSyncRuntime('get_connected_peers failed', err)
the stale-runtime branch returns inactive status with zero peers

acceptance_criteria.text: The Delphi Electron TypeScript code must still type-check after the change.
